g.text: +GameController(maxTurns: int, tableCount: int, menu: Menu, arrivals: Map<Integer, Customer>, objective: Objective)
+takeOrder(customer: Customer, item: MenuItem, bill: int): Order
GameController creates its tables, queue, staff
and scoreboard itself, and they only exist as
part of one game (filled diamond). Customers
come in from GameSetup and exist on their own
Reads the manager's numbers and prints the game.
Every choice goes through GameController. For the
display it also <<use>>s Customer, Order, Table,
actedThisTurn is private and every task calls
completeTask() first, so no staff member can
do two tasks in one turn.
Every attribute is private. A customer's status only
changes through its own methods, which refuse a step
out of order: pay() before READY_TO_PAY, or leave()
when not waiting. Order works the same way
